title: EvidenceBundleProduction
description: Production evidence bundle reference. Binds together the hashed artifacts and status references (readiness, assurance, deep-assurance, M2 protocol-gate) that a candidate operator publishes as verifiable conformance evidence. An evidence bundle is a package of reproducible, independently checkable inputs; it is NOT a certificate and by itself grants nothing. The M2 protocol-gate status is computed by the Rust engine (engines/banza-m2-protocol-gate :: validate_m2_protocol_gate), never in TypeScript. Publishing a bundle does not activate an operator, does not process payments, and does not move funds. BANZA is an open protocol.
_boundary: Production of the BANZA protocol, not financial production. BANZA is an open protocol; it does not process payments, settle value, or move funds. Licence/authorisation belongs to the operator, not to BANZA.

protocol_version.description: BANZA protocol version the bundle targets (e.g. '1.0.0').

hashes.description: Content hashes over the bundle and its manifest for tamper-evidence.

bundle_digest.description: Digest over the canonical bundle bytes.

artifacts.description: Enumerated artifacts included in the bundle, each with its own digest.

status_refs.description: References to the status reports the bundle depends on. Status values are computed by their respective Rust engines.

readiness_ref.description: Reference to the readiness status report.

assurance_ref.description: Reference to the assurance status report.

deep_assurance_ref.description: Reference to the deep-assurance status report.

m2_gate_status.description: M2 protocol-gate status computed by engines/banza-m2-protocol-gate :: validate_m2_protocol_gate (Rust). Never computed in TypeScript.

not_a_certificate.description: An evidence bundle is not a certificate.

requires_conformance_evidence_review.description: The bundle is a package of verifiable inputs; its conformance evidence is reproducible and independently checkable by any party, and grants nothing on its own. No human authority approves it.
